title: Every imported price is labelled Toronto: hammer.ts sets storeCity 'Toronto' for every vendor, so a Vancouver-area chain reads "Save-On-Foods, Toronto"
comment: DEFECTS row D-257 (also sweep Family 2 A8). Planted as rows, no code change: four vendors that do not all trade in Toronto, every row stamped store_city 'Toronto'. Their rows join the baseline, which carries a varied city per shop.
ifMissed: A place-label rule: no chain may carry one single city on every one of its rows when the chain trades in several provinces (count distinct city per seller).
